reviews.comment: everyone says its hard but its pretty light + she gives a bunch of credit but u can get an A pretty easy w/o it

Not the worst but definitely not the best. Lab is hard just like BIOL319 and her lecturing style just did not work for me as I just ended up teaching everything to myself. Lots of mandatory iClickers so attendance was necessary, but gives a ton of EC at the end of the semester AND ended up rounding my 88% to an A.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: the hype for a&p 2 pretty overrated ngl kinda easy if u just study

Dr. Taylor's exams are not very tough, but lab is what lowers your grade. She can ramble a lot, but using the textbook is helpful. Exams are application style questions rather than just knowing the concept. She offered up to 30 points of extra credit. I have heard she is a slightly better professor than Seeley. She can be a little rude.
Taylor goes on tangents, smart book homework gets longer as the semester goes on, and exams are mostly from lecture/slide content but they are dense. Overall, not the worse but not the best.

Taylor isn't as bad as people say, but she does expect a lot from her students. Her exams encourage a higher level of thinking (or so she says), but the wording was really confusing for me on a lot of her questions. Lectures are entertaining sometimes, but she goes on tangents often and I tended to zone out. Lab is very difficult, as expected.

By far my favorite professor!! Yes it's challenging, only bc there is so much material. Taylor gets straight to the point in her lectures. No practice exams, quiz yourself with AI (she recommends it). Memorize the concepts & learn how to apply them logically to clinical scenarios. Go to class, pay attention, you'll be fine. Lab is easier than 319

When I got Dr.Taylor as the prof for BIOL 320 I read most of these reviews and was nervous about her class. PLEASE do not believe these other reviews that she is horrible. She is hands down one of the best profs I've ever had. She genuinely cares and gave a few options for extra points. Just study hard for lecture exams and you'll be fine.

I personally thought that taylor's lectures and teaching styles were fun! She was funny and engaging and I thought the exams were very fair game. I will say however she is a bit odd during office hours, very talkative and interrupts you, it once took me 20 minutes to ask my first question. Lab is whats hard and drops your grade not class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go to the SI sessions. BIOL 319 you can get away with just studying on your own. Dr. Taylor throws a bunch of important info onto one crammed slide. Overall, I don't know if Seely is better then Taylor. Both are hard. I got stuck with a high C due to doing around average on the exams. The first exam was the easiest imo. Hope this helps!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Taylor is a extremely compassionate professor who genuinely cares for her students. This course is extremely challenging but if you're wanting to pursue a higher level of eduction suck it up and put in the work. Her lecture exams aren't terrible but the lab has so much material to memorize it is nearly impossible.

50% of the stuff she says is worth writing down, the rest isn't. The SmartBook hw is tedious and isn't worth studying over. Her exams are about applications on what we went through in lecture, so you are expected to understand the material THOROUGHLY. I'd wager that you can make a B or A by only joining the SI sessions. 4 exams, no finals, iClicker

Dr. Taylor was not terrible. I thought she was a good teacher and explained concepts very well. The only part that was not good was asking questions, she seemed to almost condescend you for asking, so if youre confused, just go and do your own research. Lab is lab. Actually STUDY before and if you get a good TA you'll be fine in this class.

not the best not the worst. her tests were not terrible, just study right off her slides. make sure to record her lectures and fill in things you missed. she gave around 25 points of extra credit. lab sucks. A is definitely achievable though!

Dr. Taylor is HORRIBLE to students, won't answer questions or emails. Her lectures are very boring, but if you study a good amount the lecture exams are easy. Lab is what will give you the most trouble. Be prepared to put time in and you will succeed!

Her class average compare to other professor is not worth it. I couldn't find the correct learning method for her class for the entire semester. The work that you put out for an A is completely insane compare to a B in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really feel like lecture exams aren't crazy difficult, but Dr Taylor is rude, condescending, prideful, and completely inflexible. She will not work with disabilities accommodations, does not answer questions in class, and can't help but be snarky when you make a request or ask a question. Put in the work and you'll be okay in terms of grades.

Class so bad writing this in middle of lecture. She is the most condescending and least helpful prof ever. Hates to answer questions in class and her tests are HARD. Makeup exams are all FRQ and even harder than her impossible exams. READ THE TEXTBOOK (even tho smartbook waste of time). TAKE ANYONE BUT HER. Lab somehow saving my grade (thats sad)
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Taylor doesn't care about the learning of her students. I'm not 100% sure what she cares about, but teaching her students isn't a priority. She doesn't elaborate or teach students the correct answers to practice questions for exams. The smartbook she gives us is the biggest waste of time. The fact that the lab is saving my grade is outrageous.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was a great and understanding professor. I had a lot of personal things happened to me this past semester and she was very understanding and helped me anywhere I needed. It is definitely a hard class, but she helps in anyway she can. I have also learned reading the textbook for the exams was extremely beneficial.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures are fast pace and she never repeats herself. Her slides make no sense, and have little info on them. Tests are extremely hard and she expects you to know things that she never lectured about. Attendance is mandatory and tracked through iclicker which is part of your overall grade. Overall, Taylor is rude and condescending. Don't recommend.

Taylor was a good professor, 320 is just a hard class. The lab aspect of 320 is the part that really plummets your grade. You don't really need to attend lecture, but I'm sure it is pretty helpful. She claims that she doesn't usually curve but she did at the very end by about 2%.

Lectures are almost rushed with how much material is gone through. Lecture exams aren't horrible if you study very well. Labs are horrendous and tedious and I found it impossible to pass a practical. She refused to curve the class and gave lots of extra credit work instead. Material is interesting but this class sucks the life out of you.

Dr. Taylor lectures super fast, hard to follow. Gives ALOT of information and doesn't specify what you to focus on for test, wants you to know it all like this is the only class you are in. HIGHLY unorganized. Many mistakes were made when examining lab technicalities. Sleep with your lab manual under your pillow or you will struggle.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm wondering why Dr. Taylor has such a bad reputation. My experience with her has been perfectly fine, and while she is certainly a little rough around the edges, she honestly cares about your learning. I think she's by far the best professor at A&M I've had when it comes to explaining difficult concepts. however, lab is absolutely murderous
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She comes off as mostly okay in class, but she is SO prideful and rude in private exchanges and when people ask questions. She misspeaks frequently in class, so listen very carefully and think through what she's saying while she lectures. Also, she often presents info in an unorganized fashion, which makes it a pain to learn from her. Easy tests!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have the option to take this course somewhere else, do it. It's unfortunate Dr. Taylor is your only option at A&M, but I suppose that's just how it is. She is, by far, the worst educator I have ever had the pleasure of being taught by. But I think it's largely due to A&M's anatomy curriculum, there's just a ridiculous amount of content.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Taylor is stubborn and had little regard for our concerns about the grading scale and once approached about countless issues she very rarely took them into consideration. Drop out if A&M forces you to take this class. xoxo

Honestly probably the prof I've liked the least in college. We cover SO much material, which would be fine if she gave us any sort of idea (i.e. a review) of what we were being tested over - and she goes fast. She can be very condescending and rude if you ask a question or ask for clarification and thinks her class is the only one you're in.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy
